resolution: Fixed the combat-arena lab bugs from req_0916. Root cause of the console spam (duplicate React key 'cap-undefined') AND the 'floating clothes / no body' was one type error esbuild silently passed: makeFigure was typed to return seed but the body returned {doc,parts} only, so f.seed was undefined — the four NPC CharacterCaptures collapsed to one key and React omitted three, so those figures' skin/face textures never baked and their body Globe meshes dropped, leaving only the default clothing. Fix: each figure now gets its own unique cartKey (combat_arena_player / combat_arena_npc0..3) so every dyn-slot key and capture staticKey is globally unique, makeFigure returns seed+cartKey, captures keyed by cartKey. Also reordered the Scene3D children so the one truly variable-length list (fx) renders dead-last (the repo's reconciler sibling-shift hazard) with cones as a fixed-length null-slotted list. Verified: esbuild bundle of labs/index.ts clean (exit 0), all React keys audited unique. Recorded a memory that esbuild does not typecheck so a clean bundle is not a type guarantee.
